name: Gotogra
description:
About This Game

Gotogra is a mix between a traditional roguelike deckbuilder and a tactical game.

You can move and reposition yourself inside combat rooms to gain an advantage over enemies. Deckbuilding is still a core component, and building your deck with the right synergies for your runs is vital.

Decks in Gotogra are bound to weapons. Each run starts you with some generic cards, then you choose a weapon with base damage and critical chance stats.

Your damaging cards, and their chance to land a critical strike, depend on those stats, unlike other games where each card deals a fixed amount of damage. You also have supporting cards to buff your damage and crit chance, cards to aid your movement, and some really tricky, cool cards that do very interesting things.
short_desc: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder where your position matters as much as your cards. Shove enemies into traps and into each other, chain devastating combos, choose your weapon, collect cards and heirlooms, upgrade every card and uncover what lies beneath the dungeons of Gotogra.
